full_prompt_en: The image is a square sepia-toned drawing in close-up, showing a skull-like face fused with living human eyes while a hand guides a fine brush beneath the eye on the right side of the image. The head fills nearly the entire frame, cropped across the crown, with the chin and a small area of clothing visible near the lower edge. Deep dark sockets hold two realistic eyes that look slightly upward and forward; the surrounding brow and cheekbones are exposed as pale bone-like planes. The central nose area is reduced to a dark cavity and angular bridge, while the mouth and jaw show uneven, tooth-like forms partly lost in shadow. Across the right side, a pale hand enters from the edge and holds a thin drawing tool diagonally toward the cheek just below the eye. The fingers wrap around the shaft, and the narrow tip meets a small mark near the lower eyelid. This gesture creates a second focal point alongside the eyes and overlaps the cheek. The tool is thin and dark against the pale fingers, extending diagonally upwards from the lower right towards the central eye socket. A narrow highlight follows the cheek and the back of the hand, while broad brown shadow pools below the sockets and around the lower face. The cropped view gives no clear indication of the surrounding setting. Warm beige and tobacco-brown tones model the face through fine pencil hatching and softly rubbed shading. Dark umber gathers in the sockets, under the cheekbones, and along the jaw, while pale highlights trace the brow ridge, nose, and knuckles. The background is a simple muted brown field with faint vertical tonal variation, leaving the face and hand isolated. The left temple and forehead remain comparatively pale, but their values deepen quickly toward the eye sockets and lower cheek. Fine hatching follows the brow, nose bridge, and bone edges, while softer rubbed areas merge the skull-like planes into one continuous surface. No distinct room or other object appears. The light is soft and directional from the upper left, revealing the rough grain of the drawn surface and casting narrow shadows where the hand crosses the face. The image remains restrained in colour, using a tight range of cream, sepia, and charcoal brown. Small eye highlights punctuate the dark sockets, while broader pale areas define the forehead and exposed bone-like surfaces. The overall composition is an intimate frontal crop, balancing the two eyes against the diagonal hand and brush, with the skeletal and human features merging into an unsettling, contemplative portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形棕褐色近景素描，骷髅般的面孔与活人的双眼融合，一只手正用细画笔在画面右侧的眼睛下方描绘。头部几乎填满画框，头顶被裁切，下巴及少许衣物在下沿附近仍可见。深色眼窝中嵌着两只真实眼睛，目光略微朝前上方；眉骨和颧骨周围露出浅色骨质平面。鼻子中央缩减为深色空腔与棱角分明的鼻梁，嘴部和下颌呈现不规则齿状形体，部分隐入阴影。画面右侧一只浅色手伸入，握着细长画具，沿斜线指向眼睛下方的脸颊。手指环绕笔杆，细尖停在下眼睑附近的一处小痕迹上。这一动作与双眼并列成为视觉焦点，同时遮住部分脸颊。细长画具在浅色手指前显得深暗，由右下方向中央眼窝斜向上伸去。窄窄的亮线沿脸颊和手背延伸，大片棕色阴影则聚在眼窝下方与脸部下半部。紧密裁切没有提供周边环境的明确信息。温暖米色与烟草棕通过细密铅笔排线和柔和擦染塑造面部。深赭色聚集在眼窝、颧骨下方和下颌边缘，浅色高光则沿眉骨、鼻梁与指关节勾出。背景只是带有轻微竖向色调变化的柔和棕色区域，让脸与手独立显现。左侧太阳穴与额头相对浅亮，但靠近眼窝和下颊时色调迅速加深。细密排线沿眉骨、鼻梁和骨面边缘转折，较柔的擦染区域则将骷髅般的平面融成连续表面。画面中没有清楚的室内环境或其他物件。柔和的定向光从左上方照来，显出绘制表面的粗细纹理，并在手部横过脸颊处留下窄阴影。色彩范围克制，集中于奶油色、棕褐色和炭棕色。细小眼部高光点亮深色眼窝，较宽浅色区域则交代额头与外露骨面。整体构图是亲密的正面裁切，以双眼平衡斜向伸入的手与画笔，让骷髅特征和人的面容交叠为不安而沉思的肖像。
style_prompt_en: The style relies on sepia drawing, fine hatching, and rubbed tonal transitions. Dark values gather in cavities and under projecting planes, while pale strokes pick out raised edges. The surface feels dry and granular, with line direction following changes in form. A narrow palette of cream, tobacco brown, and charcoal creates depth without strong colour shifts. Soft directional light supports gradual modelling, and close cropping keeps the image immediate. The composition pairs a frontal mass with one diagonal form, balancing detailed marks against quieter surrounding space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格依靠棕褐色绘制、细密排线和擦染式色调过渡。深色聚集在凹陷处及凸起平面下方，浅色笔痕则点出隆起边缘。表面显得干燥而带颗粒，线条方向随形体转折而改变。奶油色、烟草棕与炭黑组成狭窄色谱，在没有强烈色相变化时仍能形成纵深。柔和定向光帮助渐进塑形，紧密裁切让画面显得直接。构图将正面的大形体与一处斜向形体并置，在细密痕迹和周围较安静空间之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A skeletal face fused with human eyes as a hand draws beneath one eye
theme_zh: 骷髅与人眼融合的面孔及眼下执笔的手
name: Vincent Castiglia
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
